_prompt: Kolo 16 (Samuel: zaciatok a efekty iskier vadia, skusit inu, profesionalnejsiu hudbu vhodnu kvalitnemu produktu): vlastna skladba len pre LinkedIn verziu (public/music/bed_kratka.wav, scripts/music.py --prompt-file src/copy/music_kratka.json --out public/music/bed_kratka.wav), povodna bed.wav ostava. V skladbe kola 2 az 15 bol na zaciatku sum a vzdusny nadych (0-2 s filmu 70-90 % energie nad 5 kHz), pred zmenami stupajuce sumy a obratene cinely, uprostred zvonkohra (Gemini: detska, 'magicka' ako z fotobanky), styl akusticka gitara, luskanie a rovny beat. Pokus 1 (prompt so zoznamom zakazanych zvukov) mal stale stupajuce sumy pred zmenami (0:08, 0:36, 1:04, 1:23 aj v spektre) a styl lo-fi popu s Rhodes a praskanim platne; zakazane nastroje v prompte ich skor privolaju. Pokus 2: presny zoznam nastrojov a zmeny len pridanim alebo ubratim nastroja na dobu, bez akychkolvek prechodovych zvukov. Pokus 2 bol pouzity v kole 16 (bed_kratka_kolo16.wav), Samuel: prilis smutne (slova reflective, cinematic, felt piano, low strings a pomale akordy tlacia do melancholie). Kolo 17: nalada doterajsej hudby (optimisticka, ista, uplifting), ale bez trblietok: jasne akordy klavira, cista gitara, pevne bicie, 108 BPM, durova tonina, zmeny len pridanim nastroja na dobu. Kolo 17 pokus 1 (108 BPM, durova tonina, jasne akordy klavira): nalada spravna (Gemini valence 8/10, kolo 16 5-6/10), ale v uvode spievane 'ooh', tlieskanie a stupajuce sumy (premium 4-5/10). Pokus 2: prisne bez ludskeho hlasu, bez tlieskania a cinelovych nabehov, v uvode len akordy klavira.
prompt:
Strictly instrumental background music for a modern B2B software product video on LinkedIn. No human voice of any kind: no singing, no humming, no 'ooh' or 'aah', no choir, no vocal samples. Optimistic, confident, warm and positive, bright and forward-moving; polished, sophisticated and premium, never cheesy, never sad or melancholic. It sits under a voice-over, so the melody stays simple and the mid frequencies leave room for speech.
Tempo 108 BPM, 4/4, steady. Major key.
The only instruments are: acoustic piano playing bright rhythmic chords, clean electric guitar with a light muted rhythm, warm synth pad, electric bass, and a drum kit with kick, snare drum and closed hi-hat (no claps, no finger snaps, no cymbal swells).
Changes happen only by adding or removing instruments exactly on a downbeat, with no transition sounds of any kind.
Structure, total 92 seconds:
0:00-0:12: piano chords only, positive and gently moving, starting directly on the first beat.
0:12-1:05: on the downbeat bass, guitar, pad and drums come in: confident, upbeat, positive groove with steady energy and no breaks.
1:05-1:25: the drums reduce to kick and hi-hat, still bright and positive.
1:25-1:32: end on a bright, resolved major chord that rings out until 1:32.
